name: build a human pyramid
about: The avatar calls the others together; the biggest kneel side by side at the bottom, the others climb onto their backs in rows, the smallest on top waves, then all wobble and tumble down softly laughing.
code:
const s = (args.players || '').toLowerCase()
let all = w.actors.filter(a => a === me || !a.busy)
const named = all.filter(a => a !== me && s.includes(a.name.toLowerCase()))
if (named.length) all = [me, ...named]
all.forEach(a => { if (a !== me) w.join(a) })
me.say({ en: 'Pyramid time!', fi: 'Pyramidi!' }); w.sound('bell')
all.sort((a, b) => b.height - a.height)
let b = 1; while (b * (b + 1) / 2 < all.length) b++
const c = me.ahead(1.5), slots = []
let i = 0, y = 0
for (let r = b; r > 0 && i < all.length; r--) {
  const n = Math.min(r, all.length - i), row = all.slice(i, i + n); i += n
  let top = 0
  row.forEach((a, j) => { slots.push({ a, x: c.x + (j - (n - 1) / 2) * 0.7, z: c.z, y, top: r > 1 && i < all.length }); top = Math.max(top, a.height * 0.5) })
  y += top
}
yield* w.together(...slots.map(s => s.a.walkTo({ x: s.x, z: s.z + 1 }, { run: true, near: 0.1 })))
for (const s of slots) {
  const a = s.a, y0 = a.y, x0 = a.x, z0 = a.z
  a.yaw = Math.PI
  w.sound('step')
  yield* w.during(0.4, k => { a.x = w.lerp(x0, s.x, k); a.z = w.lerp(z0, s.z, k); a.y = w.lerp(y0, s.y, k) + Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 0.4 })
  if (s.top) yield* a.poseTo({ lean: 1.2, legL: { swing: 1.5, bend: 1.5 }, legR: { swing: 1.5, bend: 1.5 }, armL: { swing: 1.2 }, armR: { swing: 1.2 }, bob: -a.height * 0.3 }, 0.2)
}
const top = slots[slots.length - 1].a
top.feel('happy'); top.say({ en: 'Ta-da!', fi: 'Tadaa!' }); w.sound('yay')
yield* top.poseTo({ armR: { swing: 3, raise: 0.5 }, armL: { raise: 2.5 } }, 0.3)
yield* w.during(1.5, k => slots.forEach((s, j) => { s.a.roll = Math.sin(w.t * 9 + j) * 0.12 * k }))
w.sound('crash'); w.sound('giggle')
yield* w.together(...slots.map(s => (function* () { s.a.roll = 0; s.a.y = 0; s.a.x += (w.random() - 0.5) * 1.5; yield* s.a.tumble(); s.a.feel('silly'); yield* s.a.rest() })()))
me.say({ en: 'Again!', fi: 'Uudestaan!' })
